title: PE-14 causes SQL error — band columns in runTotalsMode colMap break detail query
body: PE-14 (adding detailBands to catalogCtx in runTotalsMode()) is INCORRECT and was reverted. Same issue would apply to PE-13 (buildQueryPlan's catalogCtx) — do NOT add detailBands there either, or buildDetailQuery/buildTotalsQuery will break.
